tiers.name: Easy
items: Any kind of bones (obtainable on site)

tasks.name: Highway to the Danger Zone!
tasks.desc: Enter the Wilderness by any means.
tasks.notes: Enter the Wilderness by any means.

tasks.name: Chaosteo
tasks.desc: Offer some bones on the Chaos Altar at level 12 or 38 Wilderness.
tasks.notes:
Offer some bones on the chaos altars in the Chaos Temple at level 12 Wilderness or Chaos Temple at level 38 Wilderness. Any kind of bones can be used. Spawns of regular bones can be found near the altar.
The altars are not the Runecrafting chaos altar which can be found at level 9 Wilderness.

tasks.name: Taking the Subway
tasks.desc: Enter the chaos tunnels from an entrance in the Wilderness.
tasks.notes: Enter the Chaos Tunnels from an entrance in the Wilderness. There is an entrance over the wall; a short distance north of the Edgeville lodestone.

tasks.name: Take a Potato Chip...and Eat it!
tasks.desc: View the recent wilderness kills on the death list noticeboard in Edgeville.
tasks.notes: View the recent Wilderness kills on the death list noticeboard in Edgeville, just west of the bridge between Edgeville and the Grand Exchange.

tasks.name: Hold My Beer While I PK This Guy
tasks.desc: View your bank in the Wilderness via one of the Wilderness cape sellers.
tasks.notes: View the bank in the Wilderness via one of the cape merchants.

tasks.name: Ten-uous Link
tasks.desc: Reach a score of 10 using the strange switches in the Wilderness.
tasks.notes: Reach a score of 10 using the strange switches in the Wilderness. The switches are located north of Fort Forinthry, west of the entrance to Daemonheim from the Wilderness, and east of the Chaos Temple. It is recommended to bring food and armour or complete in free-to-play worlds due to the bound skeletons and fetid zombies roaming the area. They can be partially avoided by taking a circular path around the east instead of taking a straight path between the levers.

tasks.name: Unlocked and Loded
tasks.desc: Teleport to the lodestone in the Wilderness.
tasks.notes: Teleport to the lodestone in the Wilderness. The Wilderness lodestone must be activated to complete this achievement.

tasks.name: Ex-posing Yourself
tasks.desc: Find out about the history of the Wilderness from Vala.
tasks.notes: Find out about the history of the Wilderness from Vala.

reward.intro:
Talk to Mr Ex, who is located in Edgeville, to claim the rewards for the easy achievement set:
Furthermore, Explorer Jack rewards 10–4,096 coins per completed achievement.
items: 2 antique lamps granting 10,000 experience each (in the skill of choice of level 30 or higher)
Wilderness sword 1, which grants the following bonuses:
perks: +5% chance to receive magical thread when Runecrafting via the Abyss (also works from backpack)
Free teleports to the Wilderness herb patch
Free teleports to Edgeville
Ability to locate the Hellfire bow
+100% Prayer experience when offering bones or ashes at the Wilderness Chaos Altar.

tiers.name: Medium
items: Small fishing net (must be in inventory)
hatchet (or in tool belt)

tasks.name: Don't Axe for Permission
tasks.desc: Loot a chest in the magic axe hut in the deep Wilderness.
tasks.notes:
Loot a chest in the magic axe hut in the deep Wilderness which requires a lockpick. Make sure to right click the door to pick lock it, and to right click the chests to disable the traps before opening them.
Players can use the Edgeville teleport lever or Ardougne teleport lever and travel north-east to get there.

tasks.name: Filthy Rich
tasks.desc: Open the chest in the Lava Maze with a muddy key.
tasks.notes:
Open the muddy chest in the Lava Maze with a muddy key.
Players can use the teleport of a Lava Titan for quick access to the Lava Maze. Players may need a knife or sharp weapon to cut through the spider webs. Players may buy the key from the Grand Exchange, kill chaos dwarves for it, or receive it as loot from the magic axe hut chests.

tasks.name: Hardcore Parkour
tasks.desc: Complete a full lap of the Wilderness agility course.
tasks.notes: Complete a full lap of the Wilderness Agility Course. The Agility level requirement for this achievement cannot be boosted.

tasks.name: Liquid Luck
tasks.desc: Create a luck potion from scratch whilst in the Wilderness.
tasks.notes:
Create a luck potion from scratch whilst in the Wilderness.
The achievement does not start until the grimy bloodweed has been collected and cleaned and must be done in the order listed. Despite saying it can be boosted, it cannot be boosted.
Players may want to save a bloodweed for the What Potion? hard achievement and one for the Come At Me, Bro! elite achievement, although one only needs to have to pick the herb and mix the (unfinished) potion once to tick it off in all three achievements.

subs.html: Pick a grimy bloodweed from the bloodweed plant grown from bloodweed seed in the Wilderness herb patch.
Clean the herb and add it to a vial of water.
Cut an uncut dragonstone and grind it into dust.
Add the crushed dragonstone to the bloodweed potion (unfinished) potion.

tasks.name: Notatrivialtask
tasks.desc: Persuade Noterazzo in the Bandit Camp to show you his goods.
tasks.notes:
Persuade Noterazzo in the Wilderness Bandit Camp to show his goods.
The bandits in the camp will be aggressive when the player is not skulled. To become skulled, select the 'Toggle PvP' option on Vala in Edgeville. Trade Noterazzo to open Bandit Duty Free.

tasks.name: A Barrel of Staffs
tasks.desc: Purchase a God staff from the Chamber guardian in the Mage Arena.
tasks.notes:
Purchase a Guthix staff, Zamorak staff, or Saradomin staff from the chamber guardian in the Mage Arena, located in the deep Wilderness. Each staff costs 80,000 coins.
The Mage Arena minigame must be completed before entering the sparkling pool.
Players can use High Alchemy on the staff to recuperate 48,000 back, leading to a net loss of only 32,000.

tasks.name: A Pizza the Loot
tasks.desc: Create an anchovy pizza from scratch in the Bandit Camp and give it to Fat Tony. (X/5)
other: 55 Cooking Cooking (nb)
tasks.notes: Create an anchovy pizza from scratch in the Wilderness Bandit Camp and give it to Fat Tony.

tasks.name: Wet and Wildy
tasks.desc: Use a waka canoe to travel to the Wilderness.
tasks.notes:
Use a waka canoe to travel to the Wilderness.
The hatchet may be on the tool belt.

tasks.name: I'm Just Bor-rogue-ing it
tasks.desc: Pickpocket a rogue in Rogues' Castle.
tasks.notes:
Pickpocket a rogue in Rogues' Castle in the deep Wilderness.
Rogue Enforcers and Rogue Captains work too.

tasks.name: Doyouthinkhesaurus
tasks.desc: Catch a Black Salamander near the Boneyard.
tasks.notes:
Catch a black salamander near the Boneyard in the Wilderness which requires a small fishing net, rope, and optionally harralander tar.
The Hunter level requirement for this achievement cannot be boosted. It is possible to catch the salamander with a boost, but the achievement task will not completed.
Keep a black salamander to make the camouflage potion for the hard achievement What Potion?.

reward.intro:
If the previous tiers of the area tasks have also been completed: Talk to Mandrith, who is located east of Pirate's Hideout in deep Wilderness, to claim the rewards for the medium achievement set:
Furthermore, Explorer Jack rewards 10–4,096 coins per completed achievement.
items: 2 antique lamps granting 40,000 experience each (in the skill of choice of level 52 or higher)
Wilderness sword 2, which, in addition to Wilderness sword 1's bonuses, grants the following bonuses:
perks: +10% total chance to receive magical thread when Runecrafting via the Abyss (also works from backpack)
+5% XP per lap completion at the Wilderness Agility Course when wielding or carrying the Wilderness sword
Free teleports to the Forinthry Dungeon
Improved pickpocketing rates against Rogues in the Wilderness[clarification needed]
+150% Prayer experience when offering bones or ashes at the Wilderness Chaos Altar.

tiers.name: Hard
items: Grimy bloodweed (obtainable during medium task)
Black salamander (obtainable during medium task)
Black equipment (armour for head, torso and legs, and main-hand and off-hand or two-handed weapon(s))

tasks.name: Nerves of Stele
tasks.desc: Activate and teleport from each of the Wilderness teleport obelisks.
tasks.notes:
Activate and teleport from each of the Wilderness obelisks.
This might take a while due to the randomness of the obelisks. Alternatively, players could ask a friend who has done the hard set of achievements to set the teleport to each obelisk. This does not have be completed while being opted into PvP.

tasks.name: Contract Killer
tasks.desc: Complete one of Erskine's Wilderness slayer contracts.
tasks.notes:
Complete one of Erskine's Wilderness Slayer contracts.
It is recommended to complete a minimum requirement Slayer contract (and claim the reward) such as hellhounds or greater demons, as less risk is needed and it is very fast to complete.

tasks.name: pUrE a ChAoS oF cOrPsE!
tasks.desc: Defeat the Chaos Elemental, dealing the most damage.
tasks.notes: Defeat the Chaos Elemental and deal the most damage. This means that if more than one player is fighting the Chaos Elemental, only the player who deals the most damage is eligible for completing the achievement upon defeating it.

tasks.name: What Potion?
tasks.desc: Make a Camouflage potion whilst in the Wilderness from scratch.
tasks.notes:
Make a camouflage potion whilst in the Wilderness from scratch.
The level requirements for this achievement cannot be boosted.

subs.html: Plant a bloodweed seed in the Wilderness herb patch.
Collect a grimy bloodweed from Wilderness herb patch.
Add the bloodweed to a vial of water.
Add a black salamander to the bloodweed potion (unf) resulting in a camouflage potion.

tasks.name: There's Magic in the Air
tasks.desc: Charge an orb at the obelisk of air.
tasks.notes:
Charge an unpowered orb at the Obelisk of Air.
This achievement requires at least 1 unpowered orb, 30 air runes, and 3 cosmic runes. Players will need to be on the standard spell book to access the Charge Air Orb spell.
This Magic level requirement for this achievement cannot be boosted.

tasks.name: I'm the King of the Wild!
tasks.desc: Non-ironman:Defeat the King Black Dragon with the Wilderness entrance's buff, dealing the most damage.Ironman:Defeat an instanced King Black Dragon after entering via the Wilderness artefact.
tasks.notes:
Defeat the King Black Dragon with the Wilderness entrance's buff, dealing the most damage.
The entrance buff, a 10% damage boost, can be acquired by using the artefact in the Lava Maze Dungeon to enter the lair. The cape merchant Darren is located on the surface, near the ladder to the artefact, and he can be used as a nearby banking location.
Ironmen have a different version of this achievement which requires them to create an instance of the fight. They need to choose the 'Private encounter' option on the artefact in the Lava Maze Dungeon to create an instance.

tasks.name: The Root of the Problem
tasks.desc: Harvest a Limpwurt Root from the Farming patch in the Western Ruins.
tasks.notes: Harvest a limpwurt root from the farming patch in the Western Ruins in the Wilderness.

tasks.name: Cement His Torment
tasks.desc: Defeat a Tormented wraith.
other:
One of:
• 25 Defence Defence or
• The Death of Chivalry (partial, to equip black armour)

One of:
• 25 Attack Attack or
• 25 Ranged Ranged (to equip a black weapon)
tasks.notes:
Defeat a tormented wraith which requires the use of Jennica's ring and a set of black equipment consisting of an item to fill the head, torso, legs, main hand, and off-hand equipment slots.
Only black equipment will damage the Wraith. Armour that can be worn includes the elite black armour set and Black Knight captain's armour. However, only base sets without trim seem to work. Wearing trimmed black armour will cause the player to receive the message "You find yourself unable to attack the wraith."
Head to the centre of the Dark Warriors' Fortress near 15 Wilderness. Once in the centre of the fortress near the hanging skeleton, use the "operate" function on Jennica's ring to enter the Spirit Realm.

reward.intro:
If the previous tiers of the area tasks have also been completed: Talk to Quercus, who is located near the Grand Exchange Agility shortcut on the Wilderness wall, to claim the rewards for the hard achievement set:
Furthermore, Explorer Jack rewards 10–4,096 coins per completed achievement.
items: 2 antique lamps granting 77,000 experience each (in the skill of choice of level 67 or higher)
Wilderness sword 3, which, in addition to Wilderness sword 2's bonuses, grants the following bonuses:
perks: +15% total chance to receive magical thread when Runecrafting via the Abyss (also works from backpack)
The Mage of Zamorak has a chance to teleport the player to the inner ring of the Abyss (also works if the sword is in the backpack)
The ability to un-note items with Harrison near the Chaos Temple
A new shortcut to the Air Obelisk north of Edgeville
The Wilderness herb patch will never become diseased
Ability to choose your arrival destination at the Ancient Obelisks in the Wilderness
Teleporting to the Wilderness Crater lodestone will always be a quick teleport
+200% Prayer experience when offering bones or ashes at the Wilderness Chaos Altar.

tiers.name: Elite
items: Grimy bloodweed (obtainable during medium task)

tasks.name: Lava Palava
tasks.desc: Defeat a lava strykewyrm.
tasks.notes:
Defeat a lava strykewyrm in the Wilderness.
See here for its mechanics. Do not scatter the searing ashes, as they are needed to complete the elite achievement, Come at me, Bro!. The Wildywyrm does not count. The Slayer level requirement for this achievement cannot be boosted.

tasks.name: Rev-enge!
tasks.desc: Defeat one of each revenant creature in the Forinthry dungeon.
tasks.notes: Defeat one of each revenant creature in the Forinthry dungeon. Players can bring a friend along to kill the higher-levelled revenants. Optionally, players can use a Forinthry bracelet.

tasks.name: Harming Moths
tasks.desc: Capture a charming moth.
tasks.notes:
Capture a charming moth.
The level requirements for this achievement cannot be boosted. While boosts normally work for catching moths, they will not count for the achievement.
While the game does not specify, the achievement will only complete if the charming moth is caught without a butterfly net.

tasks.name: Come At Me, Bro!
tasks.desc: Create an aggression potion from scratch whilst in the Wilderness.
tasks.notes: Create an aggression potion from scratch whilst in the Wilderness. The level requirements for this achievement cannot be boosted - the potion will be created, but the achievement will not be completed.

subs.html: Plant and harvest a grimy bloodweed.
Put the herb into a vial of water.
Add a heap of searing ashes to create the aggression potion.

tasks.name: Smooth Bakriminel
tasks.desc: Create some bakriminel bolts from scratch in the Wilderness.
tasks.notes:
Craft some bakriminel bolts from scratch in the Wilderness. The hatchet may be on the tool belt.
Make sure to speak to Mami Rimba, who resides near the wilderness wall north-west of Edgeville, first before attempting to chop a bloodwood tree for the first time. The bakriminel bolt tips must be bought from Mami Rimba.
Fletch the bloodwood logs into bakriminel bolt shafts near a bloodwood tree, and attach the bolt tips.
The level requirements for this achievement cannot be boosted. While bolts can be made with the Assist System or a skill boost, they do not count to complete this achievement.

reward.intro:
If the previous tiers of the area tasks have also been completed: Talk to Kolodion, who is located at the Mage Arena bank in the deep Wilderness, to claim the rewards for the elite achievement set:
Furthermore, Explorer Jack rewards 10–4,096 coins per completed achievement.

Wilderness sword 4, which, in addition to Wilderness sword 3's bonuses, grants the following bonuses:
perks: +33.3% total chance to receive magical thread when Runecrafting via the Abyss (also works from backpack)
Searing ashes will always drop noted when wielding or carrying the Wilderness sword
Free teleports to the Wilderness Agility Course
Wilderness sword teleports bypass the level 20 teleport restriction for Wilderness PVP mode, working from level 30 instead
5% increased chance of obtaining Ancient Warriors' equipment from killing Revenants
The ability to see Mune in the Wilderness on Fridays and sometimes on Saturdays and/or Sundays if all Wilderness achievements have been completed and all the rewards have been claimed
+250% Prayer experience when offering bones or ashes at the Wilderness Chaos Altar.
